set.body: User requested that another machine can pick up Reframe4s work including Motes, and selected Git tracking instead of a local transfer archive. Track .mote/FORMAT.json, immutable .mote/ops/*.json and a portability README; exclude local actor and temporary directories. Preserve every canonical journal byte and store identity. Validate a clean Git snapshot restores the complete issue history, including a fresh actor and directory initialization. Inspect content metadata for credentials/private messages before publication. No library/numerical changes or broader scientific admission. Current main b6a52e0.
set.title: Track canonical Mote state for cross-machine continuation
